-- Migration: add and backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
-- Mapping taken from codes.csv.
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
  ELSE NULL
END;

arguments.command: ./run-migration.sh && printf '%s\n' '--- migration script ---' && cat migrate.sql && printf '%s\n' '--- migration runner log ---' && cat .effects.log
